entities.summary: Veronica Rehn-Kivi is a Finnish politician, representing the Swedish People's Party. She was born in Helsinki, and became a member of the Parliament of Finland in August 2016, after Carl Haglund left his seat. Rehn-Kivi has been a member of the City Council of Kauniainen since 1997 and chairman of the City Council since 2015.
